import urllib.request, json, math, statistics, datetime, concurrent.futures
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
def get(sym):
 data=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol='+sym+'&interval=1m&limit=1000',timeout=12))
 fmt=lambda t:datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t/1000,datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 result={'symbol':sym,'start':fmt(data[0][0]),'last':fmt(data[-1][0]),'last_price':data[-1][4]}
 opens=[{'time':fmt(x[0]),'open':x[1]} for x in data if datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(x[0]/1000,datetime.timezone.utc).minute==0]
 result['hour_opens']=opens
 result['realized_hourly_usd']={str(n):round(math.sqrt(sum((float(x[4])-float(x[1]))**2 for x in data[-n:])/n*60),2) for n in [60,180,600,1000]}
 result['min_max_since_04']=[min(float(x[3]) for x in data if x[0]>=1792209600000),max(float(x[2]) for x in data if x[0]>=1792209600000)]
 print(json.dumps(result))
 daily=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol='+sym+'&interval=1d&limit=32',timeout=12))
 returns=[math.log(float(daily[i][4])/float(daily[i-1][4])) for i in range(1,len(daily)-1)]
 print(json.dumps({'symbol':sym,'daily_volatility':statistics.stdev(returns),'last_7d_returns':returns[-7:],'last_days':[{'utc':fmt(x[0]),'o':x[1],'h':x[2],'l':x[3],'c':x[4]} for x in daily[-3:]]}))
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as ex:

import urllib.request,json,concurrent.futures,re,html
urls={'rcp':'https://www.realclearpolling.com/polls/approval/donald-trump/approval-rating','gdprule':'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/public-search?q=China%20GDP%20growth%20Q3%202026&limit_per_type=5','btcrule':'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/public-search?q=Bitcoin%20Up%20or%20Down%20October%2017%202AM&limit_per_type=5'}
def get(k,u):
 try:
  raw=urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=20).read().decode()
  if k=='rcp':
   s=re.sub(r'<(script|style|nav|header|footer)\\b["'^>]*>.*?</'"\\1>',' ',raw,flags=re.S|re.I)
   tx=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<["'^>]*>'"',' ',s))
   tx=re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',tx)
   pos=tx.find('RCP Average')
   print(k,tx[max(0,pos-500):pos+16000] if pos>=0 else tx[:12000])

def get(sym):
 x=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol='+sym+'&interval=1m&limit=400',timeout=12))

 cdf=lambda z:(1+math.erf(z/math.sqrt(2)))/2
